description: UFD and BFD are disqualifications: each scores one more than the boats entered, vacates her place if she finished, and may be excluded like any other score.
citation: RRS 2025-2028 30.3 (U flag) and 30.4 (black flag): a boat that breaks the rule 'shall be disqualified without a hearing'. A10: 'UFD Disqualification under rule 30.3', 'BFD Disqualification under rule 30.4'. A5.2 scores a disqualified boat one more than the boats entered; A6.1 moves the boats behind her up one place. A2.1 excludes each boat's worst score (one discard). Only a BFD boat that sails in the restart has a disqualification that 'shall not be excluded' (30.4), and that is DNE.
